vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2378: tiered-execution configuration UI — edit tier table, global enable, per-issue override visibility

plan.title: feat(settings): tiered-execution configuration UI — edit tier table, global/project enable, per-issue override visibility
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: PAN-2283 shipped the tiered-execution read half end-to-end (config loading, dispatch wiring, and a READ-ONLY Settings panel). There is no way to configure tiered execution from the UI: the panel has no inputs, the config write door (saveSettingsApiPromise + writeYamlConfigPreservingComments in settings-api.ts) silently DROPS tiered_execution, validateSettingsApi has no tiered branch, and per-issue plan.metadata.tiered_execution overrides are invisible. The operator expected an editing surface in v0.42.
narratives.Proposal: Upgrade the existing read-only global Settings panel (TieredExecutionSection.tsx) into an editable one that persists through the existing config door (PUT /api/settings) with fail-loud save-time validation (reuse validateTieredExecutionConfig), plus a read-only per-issue override chip on the issue view. Config is GLOBAL: 'per project' maps to the global config door; per-project override editing is out of scope. The editor mutates input fields only; the server derives difficultyToTier/byKind on save. Validation is server-side; the frontend surfaces the 400 message inline and shows a not-saved state. The per-issue chip is read-only because no plan.metadata write door exists (PAN-1124 spec immutability).
narratives.NonGoals:
- Per-project tiered_execution editing or a per-project Settings surface / project selector (config is global; per-project .pan.yaml override is an existing additive-merge mechanism, not surfaced for editing).
- Editing the per-issue plan.metadata.tiered_execution override from the UI (no plan.metadata write door; PAN-1124 spec immutability) — chip is read-only.
- Changing the tiered_execution schema, validation rules, or dispatch behavior (owned by PAN-1791/PAN-2222/PAN-2283).
- A design mockup (self-contained existing section converted in place; not a hard-won-layout redesign).

autoDecisions.summary: 'Per project' maps to the global config door.
autoDecisions.rationale: tiered_execution is a global block in config.yaml (schema.ts:499) and the Settings surface is global with no project selector or per-project write path. Building the global editable panel satisfies the operator's need; per-project override editing is a NonGoal with the gap noted.

updateSpecStatus (pan-dir/specs.ts:287) mutates only plan.status (PAN-1124 spec immutability); no plan.metadata write door exists. Matches the issue's stated fallback of read-only chip + doc link when no write path exists.

autoDecisions.summary: Editor mutates input fields; server derives difficultyToTier/byKind.
autoDecisions.rationale: difficultyToTier/byKind are validator OUTPUT (tier-table.ts:316/328), not input. Editing raw inputs and re-deriving on save avoids drift and matches how config load already works.

autoDecisions.summary: Validation is server-side; frontend surfaces the 400 inline.
autoDecisions.rationale: Reusing validateTieredExecutionConfig avoids duplicating fail-loud logic in the browser. The validator already rejects enabled:true with an incomplete table, so 'blocked while invalid' is enforced by the existing door.
The issue requires a mockup only when meaningfully redesigning hard-won Settings layout; converting a self-contained existing section in place is not a redesign.

items.title: Persist tiered_execution through the settings write door with save-time validation

expected_outputs: a settings-api round-trip test proves PUT of a valid tiered_execution block persists to config.yaml and re-loads; an invalid block is rejected

narrative.Action: Make the config door carry and validate tiered_execution. (1) In saveSettingsApiPromise (settings-api.ts:844) add tiered_execution to the yamlConfig object it builds. (2) In writeYamlConfigPreservingComments (settings-api.ts:750, topLevelSections list ~785) add tiered_execution so the block is actually written (setIn), preserving comments. (3) In validateSettingsApi (settings-api.ts:1080) — or the PUT handler at routes/settings.ts:872 — add a tiered branch that calls validateTieredExecutionConfig(newSettings.tiered_execution, { providerAuth }) with providerAuth resolved as config-yaml/merge.ts:428 does, and returns 400 with the TieredExecutionConfigError message on failure. Because the validator throws when enabled:true has an incomplete table, this alone enforces blocked-while-invalid. Add a settings-api round-trip unit test.

items.title: Given a valid tiered_execution block, PUT /api/settings persists it to config.yaml and GET /api/settings returns the validated block (round-trip preserved).
Given an invalid tiered_execution block (e.g. a difficulty unmapped or supervisor missing), PUT /api/settings rejects with 400 and the response body carries the TieredExecutionConfigError message.
Given enabled:true with an empty or incomplete tier table, PUT /api/settings rejects with 400 (save blocked while invalid) and does not write to config.yaml.
writeYamlConfigPreservingComments preserves unrelated comments and keys in config.yaml when it writes the tiered_execution block.
Make the Tiered Execution panel editable: enable toggle + resolved-state/validation preview

expected_outputs: a TieredExecutionSection component test verifies the enable toggle calls onSettingsChange and that a server validation error renders inline with a not-saved state

narrative.Action: Convert TieredExecutionSection to editable, establishing the edit pattern the tier-table and knobs beads reuse. Add an onSettingsChange prop (type mirrors MemorySection: (next: SettingsConfig, opts?) => void) and wire it at SettingsPage.tsx:527 to applySettings. Replace the read-only 'Resolved state' block with an editable enable/disable toggle (role=switch, immediate save) bound to formData.tiered_execution.enabled. Add a resolved-state preview that reflects the global enabled flag combined with validation status (valid vs invalid-with-reason), mirroring resolveTieredExecutionEnabled semantics (global flag; no plan metadata at the settings level). Surface any server 400 validation message inline (from the autosave pipeline's error path) and show an explicit 'not saved — fix errors' state. Follow pan-style-guide: no decorative color, validation red only.

items.title: The enable/disable control is an editable switch; toggling it calls onSettingsChange and persists tiered_execution.enabled through PUT /api/settings.
When the server rejects a save with a tiered validation error, the panel renders the error message inline and shows a not-saved state without discarding in-progress edits.
The resolved-state preview renders Enabled only when enabled is true AND the config validates; otherwise it renders disabled/invalid with the reason.
Editable tier table: add, edit, and remove tiers

expected_outputs: component test covers add/edit/remove tier and inline validation error surfacing

narrative.Action: Add editable controls for the tier table on top of the fe-toggle-preview scaffold. For each tier in formData.tiered_execution.tiers: editable tier name, model (select — reuse RolesPanel.tsx/modelCatalog.ts picker), harness (select over claude-code/ohmypi/codex), and difficulties (multi-select constrained to trivial/simple/medium/complex/expert). Support adding a new tier and removing a tier. Bind edits to the INPUT fields (tiers[].model/harness/difficulties) — never to the derived difficultyToTier (that is recomputed by the server on save). All edits go through onSettingsChange -> autosave. Surface server validation errors (e.g. a difficulty mapped to zero or two tiers, unknown model/harness) inline near the offending control; no persisted save while invalid.

items.title: Adding a tier with a name, model, harness, and difficulties, then leaving a fully-mapped valid table, persists the new tier through PUT /api/settings.
Editing a tier's model/harness/difficulties persists the change; the edit binds to the input fields, not the derived difficultyToTier.
Removing a tier updates the table and persists when the resulting table is valid.
An invalid table (a difficulty mapped to zero or two tiers) renders the server validation error inline and does not persist.
Editable supervisor, by_kind, feed, escalation, and replay_threshold

expected_outputs: component test covers supervisor + by_kind + feed/escalation editing and the supervisor-required error

narrative.Action: Add editable controls for the remaining tiered_execution knobs on top of fe-tier-table. Supervisor block: model (select), harness (select), subscribe (select over all/flagged/sampled), owns_inspection (toggle). by_kind: map each VBriefItemKind to a configured tier name (select whose options are the current tier names). feed: callouts (select off/notify/corroborate), max_diff_bytes (number or null), exclude / exclude_subjects (string lists). escalation: enabled (toggle), retries_at_tier + max_promotions (non-negative integers), flounder_budget_minutes (per-difficulty minutes). replay_threshold (number constrained to >0 and <=1). All through onSettingsChange -> autosave; surface server validation errors inline (e.g. supervisor required when tiers configured, by_kind references unknown tier).

items.title: Editing supervisor model/harness/subscribe/owns_inspection persists through PUT /api/settings.
Setting a by_kind entry to a configured tier name persists; selecting an unknown tier surfaces the server validation error inline.
Editing feed (callouts, max_diff_bytes) and escalation (enabled, retries_at_tier, max_promotions) persists the values.
Given tiers configured with no supervisor, the panel renders the 'supervisor is required' validation error inline and does not persist the change.
The panel rejects an out-of-range replay_threshold (outside (0,1]): it renders the validation error and does not persist the value.
Read-only per-issue tiered-execution override chip on the issue view

expected_outputs: a component test asserts the chip text for the on-override, off-override, and no-override cases

narrative.Action: Surface a read-only chip on the issue view showing the effective tiered-execution state and override source. Read plan.metadata.tiered_execution from the full plan doc via usePlanningQuery(issueId) (queries.ts:144 -> GET /api/workspaces/:issueId/plan, which returns the full vBRIEF doc incl. plan.metadata). Render: 'tiered: on (issue override)' when metadata is 'on'; 'tiered: off (issue override)' when 'off'; and when no override is present, show effective global state as 'tiered: on (global)' / 'tiered: off (global)' (or omit when global is off and there is no override, at the work agent's discretion, but always render when an override exists). Include a link to docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md. Read-only — no edit control. Follow pan-style-guide (muted chip, no decorative color).

items.title: When plan.metadata.tiered_execution is 'on', the issue view renders a read-only chip reading 'tiered: on (issue override)'.
When plan.metadata.tiered_execution is 'off', the chip reads 'tiered: off (issue override)'.
When no per-issue override is present, the chip reflects the effective global state and labels it '(global)'.
The chip renders no input or edit affordance (read-only) and renders a link to docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md.
Document the Settings edit UI and the per-issue override-editing gap

expected_outputs: lint passes; docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md gains a Settings-UI subsection and a noted gap

narrative.Action: Add a short subsection to docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md describing the Settings -> Tiered Execution edit UI (enable toggle, editable tier table, supervisor/feed/escalation knobs, inline validation, resolved-state preview) and the read-only per-issue override chip on the issue view. Explicitly note the gap: editing the per-issue plan.metadata.tiered_execution override from the UI is not supported (no plan.metadata write door; PAN-1124 spec immutability) — set it in the vBRIEF plan.metadata instead.

items.title: docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md renders a new 'Settings UI' subsection describing the enable toggle, editable tier table, knobs, inline validation, and resolved-state preview (grep-checkable heading).
docs/TIERED-EXECUTION.md renders a note that the per-issue override is read-only in the UI and directs operators to set plan.metadata.tiered_execution in the vBRIEF.
